implementation.scope: Token numeric cursor and real tail with optional actual numeric-chain adapter; original bounded callback API remains for external integration.

validation.tested_scope: Seven cases: token miss, direct match, non-word-boundary skip, prefix mismatch before hit, empty token, hit with FP flush already cleared and direct mode-zero tail. Original side uses actual new callers and accepted 82297390/82296830/82296858, plus actual save/restore helpers. Recovered side reuses accepted token/length helpers. Selected full GPR/SP/LR/CTR/CR/XER, F0/F1/FP cache, x64 host control, ordinary RAM and parse boundary arguments/result.
validation.unvalidated_scope: Unrecovered PPC guest 82B7D270 numeric parser and its volatile effects; reused FindToken miss-path r10/r11/CR0/XER.CA are excluded. Other inputs/aliasing, invalid/error handlers, unselected ABI/FP, signaling NaNs/subnormals/host exceptions, faults, MMIO, concurrency and runtime.

numeric_chain.scope: Twelve actual cursor/token/public/route/parser/digit/binary/flags/length/copy PPC bodies, independent numeric and float output; selected ABI/all ordinary RAM/host FP control. CR1/7, miss lower volatile scratch, invalid callees, faults/MMIO/concurrency/runtime excluded.

scope: Bounded UTF-16 token-to-float caller with explicit unrecovered PPC conversion boundary; no numeric-parser recovery credit.
